title: HSK1 Gate 18 · Yuan Dynasty
explanationEn: Gate 18: Yuan Dynasty. Read the words below, then read the story out loud. The story is the same one you read on the map — this is the start of it.
explanation: 第18关：元朝。先读下面的词，再大声读短文。这段短文就是地图上那个故事的开头。
passage: 元朝的时候，中国很大。那时候的大王叫忽必烈。有一个人从很远的地方来。他叫马可·波罗，从意大利来。
passageEn: In the Yuan dynasty China was very large. The great khan of that time was called Kublai. A man came from a place very far away. He was called Marco Polo, and he came from Italy.

comprehension.questionEn: Read the first sentence again. What does it tell you?
comprehension.question: 再读第一句。它说了什么？
comprehension.answerEn: In the Yuan dynasty China was very large.

comprehension.questionEn: Read the third sentence again. Who or what is it about?
comprehension.question: 再读第三句。它说的是谁，或者是什么？
comprehension.answerEn: A man came from a place very far away.
comprehension.answer: 有一个人从很远的地方来。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the whole passage out loud, then say one sentence from memory.
comprehension.question: 大声读一遍短文，再试着背出其中的一句。
comprehension.answerEn: Any one sentence from the passage above.
comprehension.answer: 上面短文里的任何一句。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 时候 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“时候”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 时候 (shíhou) means "time; moment" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “时候”（shíhou）的意思是“time; moment”，就在上面的短文里。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 大 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“大”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 大 (dà) means "great" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “大”（dà）的意思是“great”，就在上面的短文里。

options.text: In the Yuan dynasty China was very large.
Long ago, great floods came to China.
The floods came, and many people had no home.

check.explanationEn: "元朝的时候，中国很大。" means "In the Yuan dynasty China was very large.".
check.explanation: “元朝的时候，中国很大。”的意思是“In the Yuan dynasty China was very large.”。

speakingPromptEn: Tell a grown-up about Yuan Dynasty in two or three short Chinese sentences. Use words from the list above.
speakingPrompt: 用上面的词，跟家里的大人说两三句中文，说一说元朝。
